name: ARC Commander
lore: Reach Command's chassis, landed alone to raise a foothold from nothing.

name: Ballista
lore: A Light Howitzer on the Warden's own hull, for mobile fire support.

name: Gleaner
lore: A salvage crawler with one reclaim head. It picks a battlefield clean as it drives across it.

name: Gnat
lore: A cheap tracked AA gun, fielded in pairs so one is always shooting.

name: Kestrel
lore: Corvus Foundries' light scout, nicknamed the jackrabbit for its speed.

name: Lancer
lore: Reach's basic infantry walker, built cheap and issued by the platoon.

name: Mason
lore: Corvus Foundries' basic construction crawler, nicknamed the shovel.

name: Warden
lore: The Reach's workhorse light tank, nicknamed the brick by every crew.

name: Bulwark
lore: Reach's heavy tank, first proven breaking the Blackridge Line.

name: Javelin
lore: A six-rack missile launcher built to break up armor at long range.

name: Mason II
lore: A longer boom and second reactor tap, built to follow the front line.

name: Skimmer
lore: A hover tank built to cross marsh country tracked armor bogs down in.

name: Squall
lore: Meridian Arms' answer to faster tech-two aircraft, mounted on treads.

name: Thresher
lore: A wheeled salvage carrier with three heads and point-defence lasers, built to work the front before the wrecks stop smoking.

name: Arbalest
lore: Corvus Foundries' answer to the Paladin: one long gun on a low hull that digs in to fire.

name: Mason III
lore: Tech-three tankage and a stabilized boom that keeps building under fire.

name: Paladin
lore: Corvus Foundries' breakthrough walker, built on the Commander's own rig.

name: Trebuchet
lore: A siege mortar on treads, built to level a position before the assault. It stakes itself to the ground before it fires.

name: Osprey
lore: A cheap fan-lift carrier that fields its own Salvage Drones, called the flock. Often the first thing a new base builds after its mines.

name: Petrel
lore: A light bomber that has flown every Reach campaign since Twin Shoals.

name: Salvage Drone
lore: A small, disposable reclaimer that lives and dies with its parent Osprey.

name: Shrike
lore: Reach's basic fighter, still called Shrike by pilots out of habit.

name: Swift
lore: An unarmed radar airframe, built by Halcyon Aerospace for endurance.

name: Wasp
lore: A low-altitude helicopter built for support where fixed wings cannot loiter.

name: Argus
lore: A radar, sonar and anti-missile airframe, built after the losses at Twin Shoals. A salvage ray under its nose strips the wrecks it flies over.

name: Gannet
lore: A sea-patrol drone that listens for hulls under the water and comes down to the wave tops to answer them.

name: Hellkite
lore: A four-engine flying fortress built to burn a position, not just crater it.

name: Kestrel
lore: A vector-thrust gunship built to hover over a target and grind it down.

name: Peregrine
lore: A fast interceptor built jointly to run down bombers before they arrive.

name: Eclipse
lore: A strategic bomber released sparingly, its mission known before the target.

name: Raptor
lore: Reach's air superiority fighter, crewed by veterans of the Shrike wings.

name: Thunderhead
lore: A shielded assault aircraft built to strafe through flak and out the other side.

name: Barracuda
lore: A small attack boat that runs dived, where only sonar finds it.

name: Pike
lore: The Reach's first real warship: a faceted escort that outranges anything ashore.

name: Skiff
lore: A harbour patrol hull with a gun ring on the bow, quick enough to pick its fights.

name: Trawler
lore: A reclaim tower put to sea on two hulls. It draws what sank back up as it sails, out where no engineer can follow.

name: Manta
lore: A wide, flat hull built round a radar. Its laser burns missiles out of the air and its sixteen cells put a whole ripple of missiles up to meet aircraft. Nothing on it touches a submarine.

name: Marlin
lore: The fleet's workhorse. It hears dived hulls, shoots down the torpedoes they fire with torpedoes of its own, and its bolt rifle lobs further inland than any shore battery.

name: Moray
lore: An angular hunter-killer with six tubes and ears that reach further than the Barracuda's. Surfaced, its deck gun raids buoys, offshore mines and shorelines; dived, only sonar finds it.

name: Nautilus
lore: A hull built to carry a shield generator to sea. Shells and missiles break on its dome; torpedoes run under the skirt.

name: Swordfish
lore: A narrow hull that is all launch rack. Its cells hold racks of unguided rockets, rippled out by the dozen onto a stretch of shore or a knot of ships. Point defence takes them one at a time; there are too many to take them all. It has nothing else.

name: Atoll
lore: A flight deck at sea, refitted as the fleet's long arm against the air. Its radar sees further than any hull afloat, and its missiles reach aircraft long before they reach the ships it guards. It carries no gun at all: what gets in close, the escorts must meet.

name: Kraken
lore: The Reach's deterrent. It launches from under the water: a boil on the surface, then cruise missiles that run in low over sea and shore, so only close-in guns get a shot, and late. Every launch paints the boat for everyone listening.

name: Leviathan
lore: The anchor of the sea. Three triple turrets of Arc Cannons reach further than it can see, so it fights on what its escorts and scouts tell it. Alone it is a target: weak AA, no sonar, nothing against torpedoes.

name: Narwhal
lore: A Zenith that floats: the anti-ship rail laid down the keel of a long trimaran, so the sea can shoot back at the clouds. It carries nothing else, and dies to anything that reaches it on the water.

name: Vigil
lore: A light hull built round one great search radar, so the Reach's picture of the field travels with its army. It carries no guns; its crews say the dome is the weapon.

name: Valiant
lore: A light warship for the upper air, little more than a hull, a drive and one long rail gun. The yards turn them out faster than frigates, and send them out in threes.

name: Resolute
lore: The Reach's first heavy warship of the upper air: an armoured hull laid round a single gun, with its own search radar.

name: Fulgur
lore: Too big for any foundry floor, the Fulgur is raised in the field by the engineers who will follow it.

name: Behemoth
lore: Nothing on Meridia stops a Behemoth. It walks over what it cannot be bothered to walk round, and the ground remembers every step.

name: Aerie
lore: Halcyon Aerospace's basic hangar, launching every light airframe in the roster.

name: Capacitor Bank
lore: Banked cells storing reactor output for the moments a base needs a surge.

name: Core Mine
lore: Sinks a bore shaft and sends seeker drills out under the ground for hundreds of metres, feeding on any ore seam they reach.

name: Forge
lore: Reach's basic land factory, usually the first thing an enemy tries to level.

name: Hydrophone
lore: A moored spar buoy whose hydrophones hear hulls no radar can see.

name: Materials Vault
lore: A squat bunker buffering refined ore between the mines and the factory floor.

name: Rampart
lore: A plain wall section that joins its neighbours into one rampart, cheap enough to raise faster than guns can knock it down.

name: Reactor
lore: A squat fusion drum built fast and cheap for a young economy.

name: Scavenger
lore: A salvage mast with one slow head. It charges its beam before each pull, and reaches further than any engineer can walk in a minute.

name: Sentinel
lore: A basic static gun built around the same cannon the Warden tank carries.

name: Sparrow
lore: The static counterpart to the Gnat, trusting volume of fire over accuracy.

name: Watchtower
lore: Reach's basic radar mast, raised before a base's first factory finishes.

name: Aegis
lore: A shield tower raised after Twin Shoals proved a base needs one to survive.

name: Aerie II
lore: The same hangar with a rear equipment house for tech-two airframes.

name: Barrage
lore: A dug-in heavy flak gun, the Squall's big sister, laid by radar and a rangefinder.

name: Core Mine II
lore: A taller headframe and a second bank of seeker drills, working the same ground far harder.

name: Corona
lore: Two of the fleet's interceptor lasers lifted off a cruiser's deck and set on a pole, for the bases that learned what a Javelin battery does to a factory.

name: Forge II
lore: The same hall widened for tech-two armor, a refit crews call raising the roof.

name: Hydrophone II
lore: The same buoy with a longer array streamed deeper, doubling what it hears.

name: Materials Vault II
lore: A deeper vault, dug down to hold what the mines and the salvage crews bring in.

name: Onager
lore: A static howitzer built where mobility matters less than range and shell weight.

name: Reactor II
lore: A larger containment drum around a hotter, more demanding core.

name: Redoubt
lore: A heavy static gun holding lines the Sentinel alone could not.

name: Scavenger II
lore: The Scavenger raised another storey, its head re-wound for a longer, harder pull.

name: Undertow
lore: A field mast that knots space for a mile and more around it. A ship that drops out of warp inside it comes out slow, torn and blind, and the guns below are waiting.

name: Watchtower II
lore: The same lattice mast built taller, doubling the tech-one tower's reach.

name: Aegis II
lore: The same tower refitted with a far larger reactor and a wider dome.

name: Aerie III
lore: Taller assembly gantries over the Aerie's original apron and tower.

name: Citadel
lore: A keep built round one rail cannon, for the fronts where Redoubts kept meeting walkers they could not stop.

name: Core Mine III
lore: The full deep-core rig: a crown mast over the shaft, stripping every seam in reach down to the bedrock.

name: Forge III
lore: The full tech-three hall, taller gantries on the same slab as the first Forge.

name: Hydrophone III
lore: An active array that pings the sea itself, heard across half an ocean.

name: Materials Vault III
lore: A reinforced strategic reserve, big enough to bank a battlefield's worth of salvage.

name: Reactor III
lore: The largest fusion plant in the Reach inventory, tall enough to see for miles.

name: Scavenger III
lore: A heavy reclaim tower whose beam strips a whole battlefield of what fell on it.

name: Skyguard
lore: A slow, long-range SAM battery paired with a Watchtower for the eyes it lacks.

name: Watchtower III
lore: The mast at full height, seeing clear across a battlefield the size of Twin Shoals.

name: Culverin
lore: Built from the plans of a gun the old navies laid down and never finished. Nobody aims it at a unit; it is aimed at a map.

name: Deep Core
lore: Drives a second shaft far below the pit floor and hammers it deeper with every blow. It costs a fortune for what it adds, but what it adds does not depend on the ground around it.

name: Parhelion
lore: A tracking mast and four cells that buy a city one more morning, one warhead at a time.

name: Sunfall
lore: The weapon Asteria swore it would never field on its own soil, built anyway once the districts started falling.

name: Zenith
lore: A rail cannon too heavy to move, built to bring warships down out of the clouds.

name: Exarch
lore: A walking command machine that comes ashore alone and puts up a stronghold with the nanite emitter in its claw; ARC crews call it the Exarch.

name: Artificer
lore: A construction craft that rides a gravity lift over land and sea alike and builds with the nanite emitter on its arm.

name: Outrider
lore: A fast six-legged walker that carries a radar array on a mast over its back; it goes ahead of everything else.

name: Harrow
lore: A walking siege engine in the shape of a scorpion; ARC crews learned to fear the red line it draws before they learned its name.

name: Anvil
lore: A press works under swept armour: fabricators hung round a turning ring pour nanites onto the bay floor, and the machine walks out finished.

name: Canopy
lore: Twin raised barrels on a braced column, fed from a drum magazine, filling the sky with bursting plasma.

name: Excavator
lore: A beam run straight down into the ground cuts the bore, and the ore it frees is drawn up the column round it. It draws nothing from the grid.

name: Orrery
lore: A braced mast crowned with a sensor ring that turns free of it, held by gravity alone.

name: Palisade
lore: Armoured octagons set shoulder to shoulder, their plates lapped up into spikes. Slow to build, very hard to cut.

name: Picket
lore: A squat armoured drum under a low turret: a three-barrelled repeater that tracks anything close and punches through it.

name: Reliquary
lore: An armoured mass vault between two long energy cells: one building holds both.

name: Skyforge
lore: Four armoured towers hold a lift ring over the pad; the craft is poured whole under it and rises through.

name: Slipway
lore: A floating dock of two armoured arms and a gantry; the hull is poured in the slip between them and sails straight out.

name: Power Generator
lore: Turning gravity rings squeeze plasma to the pressure inside a star until it fuses. Breach the field and the plasma spreads and goes out, taking nothing with it.

name: Anvil II
lore: The land factory at tech 2: an outboard machine bank along each wing and more fabricator heads.

name: Excavator II
lore: The rig refitted with pinch emitters that join the beam at the mouth, and a second collector ring.

name: Halberd
lore: An armoured keep under a long turret, a ring turning under it and rams working in its skirt. Placeholder text.

name: Orrery II
lore: The mast refitted with a second floating ring and braced legs; it reaches twice as far.

name: Skyforge II
lore: The air factory at tech 2: flywheel presses on its houses and more fabricator heads.

name: Power Generator II
lore: A bigger core under more rings; like every Regency generator, it goes out rather than up.

name: Anvil III
lore: The land factory at tech 3: its fabrication ring lifted on four pylons, high enough to make the battle scorpion.

name: Excavator III
lore: The rig refitted with emitter posts round the bore and a third collector ring; the beam cuts wider still.

name: Orrery III
lore: The mast refitted with a third floating ring and clamped feet; it reaches farther still.

name: Skyforge III
lore: The air factory at tech 3: a crown raised over its lift ring, and more heads hung from it.

name: Power Generator III
lore: The largest star core, held by eight pylons and a double row of pinch emitters.

name: Sunspear
lore: A great keep carrying a fusion chamber on its turret's back. Placeholder text.

name: Deep Excavator
lore: The deepest bore: a heavier lens and a beam that surges, sunk far below the ore fields.
